name: @flighthq/tool-compiler
description: Shared compiler kernel for mechanical Flight SDK target ports
author: Joshua Granick and other contributors

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run pack:check
scripts.ci: npm run clean && npm run check
scripts.clean: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { force: true, recursive: true }); require('node:fs').rmSync('coverage', { force: true, recursive: true })"
scripts.fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run format
scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
